Elliot Callender ⏹️ on X: "Good morning. Day 3 hunger striking at Anthropic. Today I'm joined by @skyparker0 who plans to hunger strike in solidarity with me for 4 days. I hope @AnthropicAI spends the relatively minor resources to warn their approximately quarter billion users about extinction risk from AI, so that I can move to their competitor @OpenAI early with the same demand. It would be bad press for Anthropic if I had to go 40+ days to pressure them. Yesterday I spoke with a few Anthropic employees, as well as someone who I think works for a16z. They were receptive and supportive of the message. A passerby also gave me this nice scarf, which I'm grateful for. I hope you all have a wonderful day. ♥️"
